// diagnostic

E0930

These marker arguments don't match the marker's signature

What

These marker arguments don't match the marker's signature

Why

Each marker declares the arguments it takes and their types, and a use must pass exactly those

Fix

Pass marker arguments matching the shared typed marker signature.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0930: Tests/UI/DSLBlocks/dsl_block_header_is_reported_once.stderr.

Error [jet.MarkerArgumentMismatch]: `#SQL` arguments do not match `SQL(row: Type{none})`
  --> Tests/UI/DSLBlocks/dsl_block_header_is_reported_once.jet:8:6
    |
  8 |     #SQL(1) {
    |      ^^^^^^
 Why: Marker arguments use the same call grammar and typed signature as function arguments
 Fix: Match the registered signature `SQL(row: Type{none})`
